analysis.title: 10/22 Mkt Internal Insight: Excess Buy flow; RC & CTA Residual Sell Tmrw; Bond Buy Pressure
key_insights: UBS S&T (Rebecca Cheong) reports +$52 bn of SPX excess buy flow on 10/22 despite SPY -1.2%. Nasdaq excess sell flow was only -$25 bn against a QQQ move of -2.9%. UBS calls this very supportive for US equities and the 5th excess-buying day on a down day so far in October.

A hedge fund unwind in AI names triggered CTA selling (4 sell triggers crossed), Risk Control selling of $20-30 bn and Leveraged ETP selling of $26 bn on 10/22. UBS says that without this systematic selling, real money buying was very strong.
UBS RMM clients bought the dip for the 5th time this month, at the 78%-tile vs 3Y. They bought the dip in 5 of 7 days so far in October, mostly in ETFs and Tech (Semis & Hardware).

SPX -1.53% on 10/22 would have triggered Risk Control to sell about $65-90 bn, of which $20-30 bn was done on 10/22 and $45-60 bn is left for the next session. UBS expects the selling to be done at VWAP before noon, given elevated futures liquidity.
Risk Control rebalance scenarios for the next session: SPX +/-1.0% means about $20 bn of selling, SPX -1.5% means $75-85 bn, SPX -2% means $145-155 bn.

There was no sign of a risk parity unwind on 10/22 and only a very small footprint of unwind this month. VIX was 19.0 with the VIX Cross-Asset Rank moderate at 45%, which UBS reads as no panic in option hedges.
Leveraged ETP rebalance is an estimated $25.8 bn to sell, of which $24.1 bn is in QQQ + Tech: $13.0 bn Semis, $7.6 bn QQQ, $1 bn MAG-7 and $2.5 bn other Tech.

Top Leveraged ETP sells in dollars: NVDA, MU, AMD, AVGO, INTC, AAPL, MSFT, MRVL, TXN, ADI. Top sells as a share of ADV: NXPI (60%), ADI (51%), MPWR (49%), MCHP (41%), TXN (40%), TER (39%), QCOM (31%), KLAC (31%), ON (24%), ALAB (23%).
CTA equities: 8 close sell triggers across ES1, NQ1 and RTY1, with the most in ES1 at 5 triggers within -2.0%. UBS expects possible morning equity weakness from Risk Control and CTA selling.
CTA bonds: 12 close buy triggers across TY1, US1 and WN1, with the most in WN1 at 6 triggers within +4.0%. UBS calls bond buying by CTAs the biggest systematic pressure for the next session.
On 10/22 CTAs crossed 4 equity sell triggers (3 NQ1, 1 ES1) and 5 bond buy triggers (2 TY1, 3 US1).
risk_factors: Risk Control and CTA selling could weaken equities in the next morning session.
Larger SPX declines raise Risk Control selling sharply: about $145-155 bn if SPX falls 2%.
Continued hedge fund unwind in AI names could keep triggering CTA and Leveraged ETP selling in Semis and Tech.
vol_and_positioning: VIX at 19.0, VIX Cross-Asset Rank moderate at 45%, no sign of panic in option hedges.
ES1 CTA exposure at 68%-tile vs 3Y, NQ1 at 31%-tile, RTY1 at 10%-tile, TY1 at 22%-tile, US1 at 19%-tile, WN1 at 21%-tile.

NQ1 has 1 close buy trigger at 29864 (ST 2.9%) and 2 close sell triggers at 28961 (LT -0.6%) and 28896 (MT -0.8%). The next sell trigger is further away at -2.1%. RTY1 has no close sell trigger and 1 close buy trigger at 2811.9 (ST +0.5%).
TY1 close buy triggers at 106.79/4.88% (ST +0.4%), 107.3/4.79% (MT +0.9%) and 107.8/4.72% (LT +1.4%), with 1 close sell trigger at 104.8/5.21% (ST -1.5%).
US1 has 3 close buy triggers at 108.1/5.29% (MT +0.3%), 108.1/5.30% (ST +0.3%) and 109.1/5.22% (LT +1.2%), and no close sell trigger within -3.7%.
WN1 has 6 close buy triggers from 109.8/5.27% (ST +0.1%) to 113.9/5.03% (LT +3.9%), and no sell trigger within -2.9%.
